spans.s: ऋतजा॑ a. right or righteous by nature.
ऋत॑जात a. right or righteous by nature.
ऋतज्ञा॑ a. knowing the sacred law.
†ऋतद्युम्न a. full of sacred strength.
ऋत॑धीति a. right or true-minded.
ऋतनी॑ a. leading the right way.
ऋतपा॑ a. observing righteousness.
ऋत॑प्रजात a. = ऋतजा॑.
†ऋतप्सु a. of right or good appearance.
ऋतय् ऋत˚यते (pp. ऋतय॑न्त् or ऋत॑यन्त्) make right.
ऋतया॑ (instr. adv.) in the right way.
ऋतयु॑ a. observing the divine law, pious, holy.
ऋतयु॑ज् a. well harnessed or well allied.
ऋतवाक॑ m. right or pious speech.
ऋतस॑द् a. dwelling in truth.
ऋतसा॑प् a. practising righteousness.
ऋतस्पृ॑श् a. loving (lit. touching) righteous ness.
ऋता॑वन् f. ˚वरी lawful, righteous, just, pious.

ऋतावृ॑ध् a. rejoicing in the divine law, holy-minded^1,
faithful.
[1] Correction submitted by AnnaRybakovaT, Jim Funderburk. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/25.
ऋतामृत n. du. truth and nectar.
